additiveCorrectionTo.rule: This receipt is append-only. It narrows and corrects the PER/TIM transport authoring base without rewriting the original bridge receipt.

reason.finding: The integrated v42 control topology was sound, but the generated PER/TIM transport shapes were not yet sufficient to issue implementation Start Tokens.
blockingDefects: PER review operation IDs, draft media type, form/rubric/typed-answer graph, response ETags, IAQ-022 actions and typed error bodies diverged from the sealed module contract.
TIM TimecardV1 omitted LOCKED and SUPERSEDED and the timecard GET response omitted the required ETag.
The exporter did not fail closed on success response status/media/schema-ref or PER problem-response projection drift.

performanceReview: Stable owner operation IDs are getAssignedReview, saveReviewDraft and submitReview; historical captured IDs are accepted only as one-time exporter aliases and are absent from generated contracts.
PATCH consumes application/merge-patch+json and GET/PATCH expose an exact ETag contract.
ReviewFormV1 uses a bounded string schemaVersion, ordered closed item graph, typed answer constraints and canonical decimal strings with at most six fractional digits.
ReviewAnswerV1 is a discriminator-bound union of TEXT, DECIMAL, RATING and CHOICE answers; CHOICE is single-select for this slice.
PER GET/PATCH/POST success responses and all required 403/404/409/422 errors have exact status, media and schema references in source, People owner and Gateway projections.
IAQ-022 exposes only create-cycle, update-cycle-draft and validate-cycle actions and remains separate from assigned-review identity.
timecard: TimecardV1 state precedence is exactly OPEN, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CORRECTION_REQUIRED, LOCKED, CLOSED, SUPERSEDED.
Timecard GET exposes the exact ETag contract.
All five Time routes have an exact single success status, application/json media and Time owner/Gateway response schema reference.
exporterGuards: The approved design-time revision WAVE5-PER-TIM-TRANSPORT-R1 is the only new snapshot replacement authority.
PER and TIM schema graphs are hash-sealed and must be byte-semantically identical across design source, owner output and normalized Gateway output.
Hostile mutations prove that a wrong success schema ref or wrong problem media fails closed.
